# React Testing Library 实战

## 核心概念

React Testing Library 是以用户视角测试 React 组件的标准库。它的核心理念是 **"测试用户能看到和做到的事情"**，而非测试组件的内部实现细节。这意味着通过角色、文本、标签等用户可见的元素来定位和交互，而不是通过 CSS 类名或组件内部状态。

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[组件测试] --> B[render 渲染]
    B --> C[screen 查询]
    C --> D{查询类型}
    D --> E[getBy 立即查找]
    D --> F[queryBy 可能不存在]
    D --> G[findBy 异步等待]
    E --> H[断言]
    F --> H
    G --> H
    H --> I[验证行为]
```

| 查询方法    | 返回值    | 元素不存在时 | 适用场景       |
| ----------- | --------- | ------------ | -------------- |
| `getBy*`    | 元素      | 抛异常       | 元素一定存在   |
| `queryBy*`  | 元素/null | 返回 null    | 验证元素不存在 |
| `findBy*`   | Promise   | 超时后抛异常 | 异步渲染的元素 |
| `getAllBy*` | 元素数组  | 抛异常       | 多个匹配元素   |

## 基础用法

### 渲染组件

```typescript
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import Button from './Button'

test('renders button', () => {
  render(<Button>Click me</Button>)
  expect(screen.getByText('Click me')).toBeInTheDocument()
})
```

### 查询元素

```typescript
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import LoginForm from './LoginForm'

test('queries elements', () => {
  render(<LoginForm />)

  // 通过文本查询
  expect(screen.getByText('Login')).toBeInTheDocument()

  // 通过标签查询
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Email')).toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Password')).toBeInTheDocument()

  // 通过 role 查询
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i })).toBeInTheDocument()

  // 通过 placeholder 查询
  expect(screen.getByPlaceholderText('Enter your email')).toBeInTheDocument()
})
```

### 查询类型

| 查询类型  | 说明                          | 失败处理  |
| --------- | ----------------------------- | --------- |
| getBy\*   | 找到返回元素，没找到报错      | 抛出错误  |
| queryBy\* | 找到返回元素，没找到返回 null | 返回 null |
| findBy\*  | 异步查询，返回 Promise        | 抛出错误  |

## 交互测试

### 点击事件

```typescript
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react'
import Counter from './Counter'

test('counter increments', () => {
  render(<Counter />)

  const button = screen.getByText('Increment')
  const count = screen.getByText('Count: 0')

  fireEvent.click(button)

  expect(screen.getByText('Count: 1')).toBeInTheDocument()
})
```

### 表单输入

```typescript
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react'
import LoginForm from './LoginForm'

test('fills form', () => {
  render(<LoginForm />)

  const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText('Email')
  const passwordInput = screen.getByLabelText('Password')

  fireEvent.change(emailInput, {
    target: { value: 'alice@example.com' }
  })
  fireEvent.change(passwordInput, {
    target: { value: 'password123' }
  })

  expect(emailInput).toHaveValue('alice@example.com')
  expect(passwordInput).toHaveValue('password123')
})
```

## user-event

### 更真实的用户交互

```typescript
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'
import LoginForm from './LoginForm'

test('login with user-event', async () => {
  const user = userEvent.setup()
  render(<LoginForm />)

  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Email'), 'alice@example.com')
  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText('Password'), 'password123')
  await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /login/i }))

  expect(screen.getByText('Welcome!')).toBeInTheDocument()
})
```

## 异步测试

### 等待元素出现

```typescript
import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react'
import UserProfile from './UserProfile'

test('loads user data', async () => {
  render(<UserProfile userId="1" />)

  expect(screen.getByText('Loading...')).toBeInTheDocument()

  await waitFor(() => {
    expect(screen.getByText('Alice')).toBeInTheDocument()
  })
})
```

### 使用 findBy\*

```typescript
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import UserProfile from './UserProfile'

test('loads user with findBy', async () => {
  render(<UserProfile userId="1" />)

  const userName = await screen.findByText('Alice')
  expect(userName).toBeInTheDocument()
})
```

## 最佳实践

### ❌ 避免的做法

```typescript
// 不要测试实现细节
test('bad - test implementation', () => {
  const { container } = render(<Counter />)
  const button = container.querySelector('.increment-btn') // 依赖 class
  fireEvent.click(button)
  expect(container.querySelector('.count').textContent).toBe('1')
})

// 不要直接操作 state
test('bad - manipulate state', () => {
  const component = render(<Counter />)
  component.instance.setState({ count: 5 }) // 不要这样
})
```

### ✅ 推荐的做法

```typescript
// 从用户角度测试
test('good - user perspective', () => {
  render(<Counter />)
  fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Increment'))
  expect(screen.getByText('Count: 1')).toBeInTheDocument()
})

// 使用语义化查询
test('good - semantic queries', () => {
  render(<LoginForm />)
  expect(screen.getByLabelText('Email')).toBeInTheDocument()
  expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /login/i })).toBeInTheDocument()
})
```

## 小结

```mermaid
mindmap
  root((React Testing Library))
    核心理念
      用户视角
      测试行为
      非实现细节
    查询方法
      getBy 立即查找
      queryBy 可能不存在
      findBy 异步等待
    查询优先级
      ByRole 最优先
      ByLabelText
      ByText
      ByTestId 最后手段
    高级场景
      异步渲染
      Context Provider
      路由测试
```

- 以用户视角测试，通过角色和文本定位元素
- 查询优先级：ByRole > ByLabelText > ByText > ByTestId
- getBy 用于必定存在的元素，queryBy 验证不存在，findBy 处理异步
- 封装 render 工具函数提供通用 Provider 包裹
